exact_source_findings: CancelScope.cancel() records the superseded generation, increments a 32-bit generation counter and enters a discard window.
Pipeline producers can reject stale work through is_stale(generation).
response_done(generation) ignores completion sentinels from unrelated older generations instead of blindly clearing the current discard guard.
The websocket router drops generation-tagged output that is stale and also drops non-current generations while the post-cancel discard window is active.

The router source explicitly documents the race where a superseded response may never emit AUDIO_RESPONSE_DONE; generation-aware filtering exists so a fresh response is not swallowed merely because the discard flag lingers.

Session release additionally flushes queues and holds a unit unavailable until SESSION_END drains; a non-draining unit is quarantined rather than reassigned, reducing cross-session stale-output leakage risk.

conversation.item.truncate remains a separate semantic boundary: the pinned router accepts it as a deliberate no-op after cancellation because client playback is treated as owner of the unheard tail. The generation fence therefore does not prove heard-prefix/next-turn-context exactness.

research_reconciliation.superseded_question: Does the pinned HF stack have any causal cancellation generation fence at all?
research_reconciliation.remaining_question: Does the combined cancel/start/late-output/runtime path preserve the fence under adversarial ordering while also preserving the separately measured F2 heard-prefix context policy?

race_sequence: start response A and capture generation/response key A
buffer A output ahead of measured playback
cancel A and clear local playback at a measured heard boundary
start response B without waiting for every A completion sentinel
deliver or observe late A audio, assistant text, response-done sentinel and old-turn tool result in controlled permutations
verify B remains live while every stale A producer remains non-authoritative
verify a late A done sentinel cannot clear or corrupt a newer cancellation/discard epoch
verify heard_fraction and commit eligibility for A never increase after interruption
verify next-turn effective context contains the admitted measured heard prefix only and excludes A's unheard tail
repeat across disconnect/release with SESSION_END drain/quarantine observation
product_negative_if: late A audio/text is emitted or played after A is causally superseded
late A completion clears a newer discard/cancellation epoch
response B is incorrectly discarded because stale A bookkeeping remains active
old-turn tool output regains current-turn ownership without an explicit causal bridge
unheard A semantics appear in next-turn effective context
a released/quarantined pipeline unit leaks old-session output into a newly claimed session

current_external_research_refresh.huggingface_local_stack: Current Hugging Face local speech-to-speech documentation continues to describe cooperative barge-in via a shared generation-aware CancelScope rather than a single transient cancel pulse.
recent_full_duplex_research: DuplexSLA (arXiv:2605.20755) reinforces synchronized speech/action timing and explicit interruption/tool behavior as separately measurable capabilities.

VoiceChat-TTS (arXiv:2608.13831) introduces explicit mid-utterance interruption control without resetting KV cache, but German production suitability is not established by the source reviewed here and no runtime lane is opened from this delta.
